objective: Investigate the 100 object-level mismatches between Table2 Ng/Nr and raw Zenodo g/r attachment row counts, including missing rows and possible nearby alternate SourceIDs.
previous_knowledge_consumed: Full-parent workflow 43600721277 completed successfully; all 781,602 Table2 objects were reconciled and 100 objects had at least one row-count mismatch.
Pinned mismatch TSV SHA-256 d33c4dc3c575e520b867d84a1b9424368b2c44176f15651abba20b585ef0c8d5; 100 unique SourceIDs.
The 55 four-field-only controls have 54 missing g-band raw attachments and 4 missing r-band raw attachments; none has both bands in the supplement.

baseline.scope: Read-only research audit; no production selector, model, thresholds or v0.2.0 changes.

change.proposed: For all 100 mismatch objects, record row-level aggregate statistics, duplicate epochs, flags, coordinate offsets and nearby alternate SourceIDs within 3 arcseconds for targets with zero raw rows.
change.scope: Research-only script, regression tests, GitHub Actions workflow and compact evidence artifacts.
change.rationale: Missing raw rows cannot be classified as low-SNR. Coordinate and epoch provenance are required to distinguish incomplete attachments, identity mapping and processing-stage differences.

correctness.before: Only aggregate raw/Table2 row counts were recorded for 100 mismatched objects.
correctness.after: Produce one object/band record for all 100 objects with row counts, time ranges, duplicates, flag counts and coordinate offsets; report alternate SourceIDs within 3 arcseconds.

reproducibility.before: No compact row-level provenance artifact existed.
reproducibility.after: Pin Table2 and mismatch TSV hashes and both raw archive/member hashes; retain only aggregate diagnostics and alias IDs.

evidence: Raw photometry rows will not be uploaded; only aggregate statistics and alternate IDs will be retained.
Mismatch lineage workflow 43612083641 is running on a standard ubuntu-latest hosted runner.
The workflow downloads the pinned 100-object mismatch artifact and Table2.dat, then verifies both raw archive SHA-256 values before scanning.
validation.blocker: Await archive download, 100-object lineage scan, deterministic tests and compact artifact upload.

root_causes: The 100 object-level row-count mismatches have not yet been traced to exact epochs or nearby alternate IDs.
limitations: Coordinate proximity is a diagnostic, not proof of identity.
Missing rows do not prove low SNR.
Image-level INFOBITS is not included in the Zenodo attachments.

findings: A coordinate/epoch-level audit can distinguish missing attachment data, duplicate epochs and possible source-ID mapping discrepancies.

open_blockers: Review all 100 object/band records and any nearby alternate SourceIDs.
Verify the time coordinate scale against both Zenodo metadata and the CDS ReadMe.
Verify workflow expressions, artifact input paths and the test ZIP newline fixture on GitHub Actions.
Review MJD/HJD value ranges against the Zenodo file description and CDS ReadMe before accepting prior phase-fold interpretations.

knowledge_carried_forward: Do not automatically remap SourceIDs based only on coordinate proximity.
Do not treat missing raw observations as low-SNR data.
Keep CPVS root cause NOT_PROVEN and preserve v0.2.0.
The new lineage scan records numeric time ranges to test the conflicting HJD (Zenodo record description) versus MJD (CDS ReadMe) field descriptions.
